Marketing.doYouReallyTake0CommissionOn: Do you really take 0% commission on orders?
Marketing.yesStrictly0UnlikeThirdPartyMarketplace: Yes, strictly 0%. Unlike third-party marketplace portals that extract 20% to 35% on every pickup order, WhitePlate operates entirely as pure SaaS software. You only pay our flat monthly plan plus standard payment processing (Stripe direct payout). All food revenue goes directly to your bank account.
Marketing.canIUseMyExistingKitchenHardware: Can I use my existing kitchen hardware (iPads, Android tablets, ESC/POS receipt printers)?
Marketing.whiteplateRunsDirectlyInsideAnyModernWeb: WhitePlate runs directly inside any modern web browser or as an installable Progressive Web App (PWA) on iPads, Android tablets, and Touchscreen POS monitors. We natively support Epson, Star Micronics, and generic network thermal printers via standard Bluetooth, LAN, or Cloud Print protocols.
Marketing.howDoesDomainMappingWorkForWhite: How does domain mapping work for white-labeling?
Marketing.onTheGrowthAndFranchiseTiersYou: On the Growth and Franchise tiers, you simply add a CNAME record in your DNS provider pointing to `domains.whiteplate.com`. Our infrastructure automatically provisions free managed SSL certificates and routes diners to your dedicated domain (e.g., `order.yourrestaurant.com`) without showing WhitePlate branding.
Marketing.canIManageMultipleKitchenStationsE: Can I manage multiple kitchen stations (e.g. Grill vs Bar)?
Marketing.yesThroughOurStationRoutingRulesMenu: Yes! Through our Station Routing rules, menu categories automatically assign tickets to specific screens. Cold beverages and cocktails route to the Bar Station tablet, while hot items route to the Cook Line station. The expediter screen unifies them before signaling pickup to the customer.
Marketing.doIOwnMyGuestListAnd: Do I own my guest list and contact data?
Marketing.value100AggregatorsDeliberatelyShieldDin: 100%. Aggregators deliberately shield diner contact info from restaurants. With WhitePlate, you own your customer database. Export diner emails, telephone numbers, and order histories at any time with a single click, or hook into Klaviyo and Mailchimp for automated marketing.
